svg.title: The initial periodic planar vortex train
svg.desc: Contours of the Gaussian stream function in section 3 of the November 2026 Hexagon preprint by Tristan Buckmaster, Matei P. Coiculescu, and Chen Li. Closed streamlines circle three regularly spaced vortex centers. Weaker contours extend through adjacent periods. The plotted spacing is c = 6.
svg.metadata: Original level-set drawing after the initial stream function in Buckmaster, Coiculescu and Li, Non-Uniqueness of Leray–Hopf Solutions to the Unforced Three-Dimensional Navier–Stokes Equations (6 November 2026), section 3, p. 8. https://hexagonmath.org/2611.00143v1
